g.title: S0 · Installation and first program Tutorial ch. 1–3 · Manual ch. intro Difficulty 29/100 · exercisable today 40% Real mastery 1.4% · theoretical 3.5% Linux seed at stage E0, Windows seed only as a file: you start with the JS interpreter.

g.title: S1 · Lexicon, values, printing Tutorial ch. 4–5 · Manual ch. 1–2 Difficulty 38/100 · exercisable today 90% Real mastery 5.5% · theoretical 8.0% print/println rules and equality to learn by heart.

Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif

g.title: S2 · Variables, operators, precedence Tutorial ch. 6–7 · Manual ch. 3–4 Difficulty 40/100 · exercisable today 95% Real mastery 10.0% · theoretical 12.8% Integer-only arithmetic in the JS interpreter (no / and no Float).

Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif

g.title: S3 · Control flow Tutorial ch. 8 · Manual ch. 5.1–5.3 Difficulty 32/100 · exercisable today 92% Real mastery 13.5% · theoretical 16.6% if/elseif/else, while, break/continue, let and begin.

g.title: S4 · Functions Tutorial ch. 9 · Manual ch. 6 Difficulty 37/100 · exercisable today 95% Real mastery 17.7% · theoretical 21.0% Three definition forms, return, recursion, !io effect.

Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif

g.title: S5 · Lambda, closures, scope Tutorial ch. 10 · Manual ch. 8 Difficulty 53/100 · exercisable today 85% Real mastery 23.1% · theoretical 27.3% Named functions do not reassign globals; the seed captures by value.

Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif

g.title: S6 · Lists, strings, symbols Tutorial ch. 11–12 · Manual ch. 9–10 Difficulty 53/100 · exercisable today 55% Real mastery 26.5% · theoretical 33.6% On the Windows seed, lists of integers only and get(xs, i) starting at 0.

g.title: S7 · Runtime errors Tutorial ch. 14 · Manual ch. 11, 27 Difficulty 33/100 · exercisable today 90% Real mastery 30.1% · theoretical 37.5% Errors as values in Core; structured Err only in Full.
